{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/bin/bash
# Enhanced monitor: checks training exit code before starting eval
# Usage: bash monitor_with_exitcheck.sh <TRAIN_PID> <EVAL_SCRIPT> <LOG>
#
# Since this monitor is NOT the parent of the training process,
# we use /proc/$PID and an exit-code sidecar file pattern.
# The training launcher should write exit code:
#   bash train.sh; echo $? > /tmp/train_exit_code_<PID>

TRAIN_PID=$1
EVAL_SCRIPT=$2
LOG=$3

if [ -z "$TRAIN_PID" ] || [ -z "$EVAL_SCRIPT" ] || [ -z "$LOG" ]; then
    echo "Usage: $0 <TRAIN_PID> <EVAL_SCRIPT> <LOG>"
    exit 1
fi

EXIT_CODE_FILE="/tmp/train_exit_code_${TRAIN_PID}"

echo "[$(date -u)] Monitor started for PID $TRAIN_PID" >> "$LOG"
echo "[$(date -u)] Exit code file: $EXIT_CODE_FILE" >> "$LOG"

while true; do
    if ! ps -p $TRAIN_PID > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "[$(date -u)] PID $TRAIN_PID gone." >> "$LOG"

        # Wait briefly for exit code file to be written
        sleep 5

        if [ -f "$EXIT_CODE_FILE" ]; then
            EXIT_CODE=$(cat "$EXIT_CODE_FILE")
            echo "[$(date -u)] Exit code from sidecar: $EXIT_CODE" >> "$LOG"
        else
            echo "[$(date -u)] WARNING: No exit code file found. Assuming failure." >> "$LOG"
            EXIT_CODE=1
        fi

        if [ "$EXIT_CODE" -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "[$(date -u)] Training completed successfully. Starting eval..." >> "$LOG"
            bash "$EVAL_SCRIPT" >> "$LOG" 2>&1
            echo "[$(date -u)] Eval finished." >> "$LOG"
        elif [ "$EXIT_CODE" -eq 124 ]; then
            echo "[$(date -u)] TIMEOUT (exit 124)! Training killed by timeout. NOT starting eval." >> "$LOG"
            mkdir -p /home/sonny/exec-sim-repair-verifier/artifacts/eval_summaries
            echo "TIMEOUT_${TRAIN_PID}_$(date -u +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)" > /home/sonny/exec-sim-repair-verifier/artifacts/eval_summaries/alert_timeout.flag
        else
            echo "[$(date -u)] Training failed with exit code $EXIT_CODE. NOT starting eval." >> "$LOG"
            mkdir -p /home/sonny/exec-sim-repair-verifier/artifacts/eval_summaries
            echo "FAILED_${EXIT_CODE}_${TRAIN_PID}_$(date -u +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)" > /home/sonny/exec-sim-repair-verifier/artifacts/eval_summaries/alert_failed.flag
        fi
        exit $EXIT_CODE
    fi
    echo "[$(date -u)] PID $TRAIN_PID still running" >> "$LOG"
    sleep 300
done

cat > /home/sonny/exec-sim-repair-verifier/monitor_qwen_s456_eval.sh << 'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
# Monitor Qwen s456 training PID 83243 → auto-eval on success
# Checks: exit code sidecar + checkpoint-6633 verification

TRAIN_PID=83243
EXPECTED_STEP=6633
CKPT_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints_repo_cwm_8b_s456"
EVAL_SCRIPT="/home/sonny/exec-sim-repair-verifier/eval_qwen_cwm_s456.sh"
LOG="/home/sonny/exec-sim-repair-verifier/monitor_qwen_s456_eval.log"

echo "[$(date -u)] Monitor started for PID $TRAIN_PID (expected final step: $EXPECTED_STEP)" >> "$LOG"

# Poll until training PID disappears
while ps -p $TRAIN_PID > /dev/null 2>&1; do
    # Log current max checkpoint for progress tracking
    CUR_STEP=$(ls -d ${CKPT_DIR}/checkpoint-* 2>/dev/null | awk -F'checkpoint-' '{print $NF}' | sort -n | tail -1)
    echo "[$(date -u)] PID $TRAIN_PID running — latest checkpoint: ${CUR_STEP:-none}" >> "$LOG"
    sleep 120
done

echo "[$(date -u)] PID $TRAIN_PID gone." >> "$LOG"
sleep 10

# Check 1: exit code sidecar
EXIT_CODE_FILE="/tmp/train_exit_code_${TRAIN_PID}"
if [ -f "$EXIT_CODE_FILE" ]; then
    EXIT_CODE=$(cat "$EXIT_CODE_FILE")
    echo "[$(date -u)] Exit code from sidecar: $EXIT_CODE" >> "$LOG"
    if [ "$EXIT_CODE" -ne 0 ]; then
        echo "[$(date -u)] ABORT: Training failed (exit $EXIT_CODE). NOT starting eval." >> "$LOG"
        mkdir -p /home/sonny/exec-sim-repair-verifier/artifacts/eval_summaries
        echo "FAILED_${EXIT_CODE}_${TRAIN_PID}_$(date -u +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)" > /home/sonny/exec-sim-repair-verifier/artifacts/eval_summaries/alert_s456_failed.flag
        exit 1
    fi
else
    echo "[$(date -u)] No sidecar exit code file — will verify via checkpoint." >> "$LOG"
fi

# Check 2: verify final checkpoint step == 6633
MAX_STEP=$(ls -d ${CKPT_DIR}/checkpoint-* 2>/dev/null | awk -F'checkpoint-' '{print $NF}' | sort -n | tail -1)
echo "[$(date -u)] Max checkpoint step: ${MAX_STEP:-NONE} (expected: $EXPECTED_STEP)" >> "$LOG"

if [ -z "$MAX_STEP" ]; then
    echo "[$(date -u)] ABORT: No checkpoints found at all!" >> "$LOG"
    exit 1
fi

if [ "$MAX_STEP" != "$EXPECTED_STEP" ]; then
    echo "[$(date -u)] ABORT: Checkpoint mismatch! Max=$MAX_STEP expected=$EXPECTED_STEP. NOT starting eval." >> "$LOG"
    echo "[$(date -u)] Available checkpoints:" >> "$LOG"
    ls -d ${CKPT_DIR}/checkpoint-* >> "$LOG" 2>&1
    mkdir -p /home/sonny/exec-sim-repair-verifier/artifacts/eval_summaries
    echo "CKPT_MISMATCH_${MAX_STEP}_${TRAIN_PID}_$(date -u +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)" > /home/sonny/exec-sim-repair-verifier/artifacts/eval_summaries/alert_s456_ckpt_mismatch.flag
    exit 1
fi

# All checks passed
echo "[$(date -u)] All checks PASSED (exit=OK, checkpoint=$MAX_STEP). Starting eval..." >> "$LOG"
bash "$EVAL_SCRIPT" >> "$LOG" 2>&1
EVAL_EXIT=$?
echo "[$(date -u)] Eval finished with exit code $EVAL_EXIT" >> "$LOG"
exit $EVAL_EXIT
SCRIPT
chmod +x /home/sonny/exec-sim-repair-verifier/monitor_qwen_s456_eval.sh
